theorems.name: Overlap parity is a gauge 1-cochain
theorems.statement: The sign of each S4 chart transition changes by the sum of the endpoint chart-frame parities, so six edge bits are defined only modulo vertex coboundary.
theorems.status: EXACT FINITE THEOREM / CHECKER AND LEAN CORE

theorems.name: Three complete triangle invariants
theorems.statement: The triangle parities on 012, 013 and 023 are gauge invariant, independent, and determine the fourth triangle parity and the full H1(K4,F2) class.
theorems.status: EXACT FINITE THEOREM / EXHAUSTIVE CHECKER / LEAN CORE

theorems.name: A4 reduction criterion
theorems.statement: A four-chart S4 transition atlas can be relabeled so that every overlap lies in A4 iff all three independent triangle parities vanish.
theorems.status: CONSTRUCTIVE EXACT THEOREM / EXHAUSTIVE CHECKER / LEAN CORE

theorems.name: Explicit reduction gauge
theorems.statement: For edge bits e01,e02,e03,e12,e13,e23 with zero triangle holonomies, the vertex gauge (0,e01,e02,e03) clears every edge bit.
theorems.status: EXACT FORMULA / CHECKER AND LEAN CORE

theorems.name: Uniqueness up to global reversal
theorems.statement: On connected K4, any two gauges clearing all edge parities differ by one common C2 bit at every vertex.
theorems.status: EXACT THEOREM / EXHAUSTIVE CHECKER / LEAN CORE

theorems.name: Orientation obstruction class
theorems.statement: The eight gauge classes of edge parities form H1(K4,F2)=F2^3 and are the possible first orientation classes w1 of an unstructured four-slice native atlas.

theorems.name: Global Euler generator iff w1 vanishes
theorems.statement: The local slice generators admit a globally coherent sign iff the transition parity class is zero; when it exists the coherent sign is unique up to simultaneous reversal.
theorems.boundary: Requires a future native construction of the S4-valued overlap transports.

theorems.name: Concrete FCC carrier is oriented
theorems.statement: The regular tetrahedral carrier admits all overlap transports in A4, so its ordinary chirality obstruction class is zero.
theorems.status: DERIVED FROM TETRAHEDRAL ORIENTATION LOCAL-SYSTEM THEOREM
